pagedata.pyDescription: select CLAIMNO as "Country",NilaiOS as "District",NilaiAksep as "DistrictID",Currencys as "Currency",rownum as "City",BUSINESSGROUPID as "BusinessID",BusinessName as "BusinessName",salvage_value as "NoteKasir",LBU_ID as "AlasanKlaim",IDCURRENCY as "CASEDB" from (select CLAIMNO,sum(OS_VALUE*CLAIM_OR*CLAIM_SHARE_ASM) as NilaiOS,sum(AKSEP_VALUE*CLAIM_OR*CLAIM_SHARE_ASM) as NilaiAksep, sum(case when PAYMENTTYPE = '3' then (case when AKSEP_VALUE<0 then AKSEP_VALUE*-1 else AKSEP_VALUE end * claim_or*CLAIM_SHARE_ASM) else 0 end) as salvage_value,(select distinct(LBU_ID) from v_klaim@asmd.sinarmas.co.id where no_klaim=CLAIMNO) as LBU_ID ,(SELECT a.CURRENCY FROM POOLDATA.CURRENCY a where ID=x.CURRENCY) as Currencys,x.CURRENCY as IDCURRENCY,BUSINESSGROUPID,(SELECT BUSINESSGROUPNAME FROM POOLDATA.BUSINESS b WHERE X.BUSINESSGROUPID = B.BUSINESSGROUPID and rownum=1) AS BusinessName from Pooldata.T_CLAIM_XOL x where col_desc={getDetailXOL.CauseOfLoss} and to_char(DATEOFLOSS,'dd/mm/yyyy')={getDetailXOL.NoKTP} group by CLAIMNO,BUSINESSGROUPID,CURRENCY) order by BUSINESSGROUPID
